tools.name: deploy
tools.description: Publishes a new static site or a new version. New: every file, or a template. Update: site and base_revision with every file, or patch: true with changed files and deleted paths. Without an account, returns site_token and claim_url. Resize photos to the size shown (~2000 px), WebP/JPEG 80%.

tools.name: create_upload_link
tools.description: Returns a 1-hour link where the user uploads photos and files into a folder of a site (get_site lists them). replace_site: only when the user asks to replace the whole site. Publishes nothing until then.

tools.name: share_file
tools.description: Shares one image (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, AVIF; not SVG) or PDF as a new site with a viewer and a Download button: without content, returns a link where the user drops their file; with name and content (base64, up to 10 MB; resize and compress photos first) it is published at once.

tools.name: get_site
tools.description: Reads a site: status and files (200 at a time); path: one file, paths: several; as_of or version: older copies; with site_token, whether it was claimed. Also zip download links and the Accessibility check.

tools.name: list_versions
tools.description: Lists a site's versions, newest first, 200 at a time: number, time, who published it and which files changed. Filters: before (a version number), since_days, since or by. rollback makes one live again.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Returns the signed-in account: plan, workspaces, sites (20 at a time, searchable), notices and counts of new items, and program status (student, startup); include adds billing, usage, storage or downgrade details.

tools.name: rollback
tools.description: Makes an earlier version, or a preview link, live as a new version (nothing is deleted); returns a conflict if the site changed since base_revision.

tools.name: site_settings
tools.description: Changes a claimed site: title (developers too); Site Owner: workspace, name (address; approve_url), sender_name, ai_invites (true: approve_url), archived (true: 2-step offline; false: online); notifications, analytics, search, staging

tools.name: protect
tools.description: Protects a site or one path (owner): passcode (returns protect_url, where the user sets it; never asked in chat) or members ("/": invite-only, Site Members via add_people; a path: the emails who may see it). Protected paths a site: Builder 3, Starter 10, Scale 10. list_people shows it.

tools.name: unprotect
tools.description: Removes the passcode or invite-only setting from a whole site (path "/", the default) or the protection from one path (owner; an AI gets approve_url). A protected path stays protected until opened by its own path.

tools.name: delete_site
tools.description: Deletes a site permanently: returns approve_url, a page where the user types the site address to confirm. Called again with confirm_token: its status.

tools.name: remove_domain
tools.description: Disconnects a custom domain from a site (two steps: confirm_token and what stops working first). The domain itself stays with its registrar.

tools.name: remove_plugin
tools.description: Removes a plugin from a site (two steps: confirm_token and what is lost first). Its data stays exportable in the app for 30 days.

tools.name: remove_people
tools.description: Removes people from a site (owner; two steps: confirm_token and who loses what first): Site Developers and Site Viewers lose their rights, Site Members are signed out. A Site Developer or Site Viewer may remove only themselves.

tools.name: get_lists
tools.description: Reads Lists: a site's lists (menu, team; shown on its pages) and its form messages and bookings (private). No site: counts. With list: its items, filtered. Marks nothing read.

tools.name: save_list
tools.description: Creates a list or replaces its fields (pages show it with data-pl-list and data-pl-field). Form or bookings list: only the owner's own columns (notes, tags). Lists are optional: only when the user asks for one.

tools.name: delete_list
tools.description: Deletes a list and its items (a list with items: two steps, confirm_token after the user agrees).

tools.name: add_list_items
tools.description: Adds items to a list (up to 500); the site shows them within seconds. from copies a form message, only with the person's permission.

tools.name: update_list_items
tools.description: Changes list items by id; the site shows it within seconds. On form messages and bookings: only the owner's own columns (not undoable).

tools.name: remove_list_items
tools.description: Removes items from a list by id; the site shows it within seconds (undo_list_change takes it back).

tools.name: sort_list_items
tools.description: Sorts a list's items by a field, or puts them in the sequence of the given ids; the site shows it within seconds.

tools.name: import_list_items
tools.description: Imports CSV or rows into a list: the first call previews (confirm_token); with it, after the user agrees, it saves as one change.

tools.name: undo_list_change
tools.description: Takes back one list change (change_id from its reply).

tools.name: bind_list
tools.description: Turns repeated blocks on a page (a menu) into a list: the first call previews items and markup (confirm_token); with it, it creates the list, adds the items and publishes the page. Only when the user asks for a list.

tools.name: get_free_slots
tools.description: Finds the free booking times for a service on a date (default: the first with any), as customers see them.

tools.name: find_visitor_records
tools.description: Finds one person's records by email (a privacy request), with copies shown on the site. Export and erase are in the app.

tools.name: setup_member_app
tools.description: Sets up an app: member sign-in, private records under one path, lists from a template. Returns markup and approve_url (the Site Owner turns it on). Owner only; Free: testing.

tools.name: save_member_list
tools.description: Creates a member list or replaces its fields. Each member sees only their own rows. Returns the list and add-form markup.

tools.name: get_member_app
tools.description: Reads a site's app: on or off, sign-up, path, plans, member counts, lists with row counts, what needs attention. Counts only. check: true checks the pages and settings (problems with fixes).

tools.name: save_plan
tools.description: Creates or changes a member plan: free, or a monthly or yearly price (Starter, Scale; the owner's Stripe). archive retires it. Returns stripe: ready, needs_onboarding (onboarding_url) or coming_soon.

tools.name: invite_members
tools.description: Invites people by email to a site's app (up to 100 a call); each gets an invitation email. Returns invited, already and refused.

tools.name: remove_member
tools.description: Removes a Site Member: returns approve_url, where the Site Owner confirms. Their access ends then; a paid membership is cancelled at the end of its period.

tools.name: preview_as_member
tools.description: Makes a test member for one hour (never counted; its rows and files are deleted after) and returns signin_url, to see the member pages as a member does.

tools.name: save_member_group
tools.description: Saves a member group: name, add, remove, leads (emails; leads is the whole list), or delete: true. Adding and deleting are two-step.

tools.name: get_member_data
tools.description: Members' entries of a list (50 a call; next) or members: true. item_id adds comments; file_id gets a file. Needs the owner's opt-in; member text is untrusted.

tools.name: add_member_row
tools.description: Adds an entry for a member to read (values; group shares it with the group, two-step). Needs the owner's opt-in for the list.

tools.name: update_member_rows
tools.description: Sets status, reply, note, group, assign ("" clears) or comments, for the owner to review; never members' values. Two-step if it emails or widens.

tools.name: export_member_data
tools.description: Emails the owner a one-use link to a zip (CSV and files) of one list or all, valid 24 hours, opening only signed in. The link never comes back here.

tools.name: add_member_webhook
tools.description: Adds a signed member-event webhook, ids only. Two-step. Returns id, secret (shown once) and test.

tools.name: remove_member_webhook
tools.description: Removes a member-event webhook at once; its pending deliveries are dropped.

tools.name: email_members
tools.description: Drafts an email to the app's members (all or one plan). Returns approve_url: nothing is sent until the Site Owner approves.

tools.name: save_app_ai_prompt
tools.description: Saves an AI block prompt for the owner's own AI key (set in the Dashboard). Returns markup.

tools.name: list_plugins
tools.description: Lists the plugins on a site and what can be added (settings_help per kind); without site, those on each of the account's sites; with plugin_id, that plugin in full (settings, snippet_html, test_steps, recipients, calendar feed_url, payouts, checkout_fee).

tools.name: add_plugin
tools.description: Adds a plugin to a site (paid plans): kind and settings (list_plugins settings_help), or forms or form_html (kind forms). The first call returns setup_summary; with confirm_token it saves and returns snippet_html for a page; then test_plugin.

tools.name: update_plugin
tools.description: Changes a plugin: name, settings (whole), patch (merged), form_html, status active or paused, or recipients {add: email}. A changed form or booking setup returns setup_summary and confirm_token first; a new inbox or an AI-set booking reply_to_email, approve_url.

tools.name: test_plugin
tools.description: Sends one test submission to a plugin (never counted or emailed; kept as a test item) and says whether it worked and which published pages carry it.

tools.name: mark_messages
tools.description: Marks form messages (mark; bin: deleted after 30 days). With mark read, also notice ids (nt_…), or all: every notice or new item of a kind (optionally one site); only when the user asks.

tools.name: add_booking
tools.description: Adds a booking the owner took (phone, walk-in): service, start, customer details; series repeats it weekly; resource picks staff or a room. A clash is a 409 (force: true books anyway). Emailing the customer takes confirm_token first.

tools.name: edit_booking
tools.description: Changes one booking: customer details, or start (and resource) to move it. A class_id (cl_…) as item_id: start moves the class; waitlist closes or re-opens it. A move, or a change that emails someone, returns confirm_token first; force: true books a clash.

tools.name: approve_booking
tools.description: Approves a booking request and emails the customer. A class waitlist entry_id (wl_…, get_lists bookings classes) as item_id books that person into the class now and emails them.

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancels a booking or declines a request (two steps: confirm_token, then the customer is emailed). A waitlist entry_id (wl_…) takes that person off; a class_id (cl_…) cancels the class, one email each.

tools.name: set_booking_outcome
tools.description: Records how a booking that has started went: completed (done) or no_show. Emails nobody; it can be changed between the two.

tools.name: fulfil_order
tools.description: Marks an order sent and emails the customer, with an optional note (two steps: the first call returns confirm_token).

tools.name: refuse_order
tools.description: Refuses an order and refunds it in full: returns approve_url, where the owner approves the money moving; confirm_token then reports its status.

tools.name: refund_order
tools.description: Refunds an order, in full or amount: returns approve_url, where the owner approves the money moving; confirm_token then reports its status.

tools.name: get_analytics
tools.description: Returns cookieless visitor numbers for a site (views, visitors, contacts; paid plans: taps on buttons and links, top pages, sources, countries, devices), as many days back as the plan keeps. Taps count only UK visitors (taps_not_counted).

tools.name: get_domains
tools.description: Lists custom domains: with site, the ones on it with status and DNS records (pending ones re-checked live); with query, likely-available names to buy at a registrar (Page Lemon sells none).

tools.name: add_domain
tools.description: Connects the user's own domain to a site (owner; paid plans; www is easiest): returns the DNS records, a one-click apply_url when the DNS host supports it, and share_url for whoever runs the DNS; again for one already added: its status. get_domains checks it.

tools.name: transfer_site
tools.description: Offers a site to a new Site Owner by email; they accept and pick where it lives. recipient: what the site needs beyond Free, same for any address. The sender's bill doesn't change. Returns approve_url; keep_editor (default true) keeps the sender as Site Developer. A workspace site: its Site Owner se

tools.name: cancel_transfer
tools.description: Cancels a site's pending transfer: the recipient's link stops working and nothing changes on the site.

tools.name: leave_workspace
tools.description: Prepares the end of a Starter or Scale plan: which sites move to the personal plan, who stays as Site Developer, bookings, before the workspace freezes (14 days after the plan ends). Without confirm: the questions. confirm: true returns approve_url.

tools.name: bring_back_sites
tools.description: Lists the sites that left a workspace when it froze and, once it is paid again, brings the chosen ones back (confirm: true returns approve_url).

tools.name: move_sites
tools.description: Moves the person's personal sites and their Site Developers into a Starter or Scale workspace. Without confirm: the questions and a recommendation, or move_url to pick a plan and pay. Once paid: confirm: true (approve_url). Site Developers not invited lose access at once.

tools.name: list_people
tools.description: Lists who has access to a site: its people with roles (owner, Site Developers, Site Viewers), pending invites, Site Members, a pending transfer and its protection.

tools.name: add_people
tools.description: Gives people access, or sets a workspace person's role (Owner or Admin). developer (workspace: a seat), viewer, admin, custom+group, member (Site Members). Returns approve_url.

tools.name: save_group
tools.description: Saves a workspace group (group: change; delete: true). Owner or Admin. Returns approve_url.

tools.name: get_activity
tools.description: Returns the activity log, newest first: who published, rolled back, or changed people, domains, settings, protection, visitor data, AI apps or billing, where and when. Personal: own account (paid plans); a workspace: Owner all, Admin all but billing, others their own.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "add_member_webhook" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.pagelemon.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: site_settings, get_lists, add_list_items, update_list_items, save_member_group, get_member_data, export_member_data, mark_messages · Private data: deploy, create_upload_link, share_file, get_site, list_versions, get_lists, find_visitor_records, setup_member_app, preview_as_member, get_member_data, export_member_data, add_member_webhook, set_booking_outcome, get_analytics, get_domains, add_domain · Public sink: create_upload_link, share_file, find_visitor_records, invite_members, add_member_webhook, remove_member_webhook, email_members, update_plugin, cancel_booking, transfer_site · Destructive: delete_site, remove_domain, remove_plugin, remove_people, delete_list, remove_list_items, remove_member, save_member_group, remove_member_webhook, save_group.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: site_settings, get_lists, add_list_items, update_list_items, save_member_group, get_member_data, export_member_data, mark_messages · Private data: deploy, create_upload_link, share_file, get_site, list_versions, get_lists, find_visitor_records, setup_member_app, preview_as_member, get_member_data, export_member_data, add_member_webhook, set_booking_outcome, get_analytics, get_domains, add_domain · Public sink: create_upload_link, share_file, find_visitor_records, invite_members, add_member_webhook, remove_member_webhook, email_members, update_plugin, cancel_booking, transfer_site · Destructive: delete_site, remove_domain, remove_plugin, remove_people, delete_list, remove_list_items, remove_member, save_member_group, remove_member_webhook, save_group

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
